best_idea: Give each zone a small data record (day bed, night bed, battle track, up to three stingers, a 0..127 bed volume) and crossfade beds on zone change, while a voice pool gives each enemy one voice and steals the weakest voice when the pool is capped.
decision_why: Keep the zone-bed record, the 0..127 curve and the one-voice-per-object rule; the donor's hard stop-then-start, unplayed battle data and unused priority are defects fixed in the sketch, so the idea is adapted rather than taken as is.
acceptance: A client test asserts bedGain(127) = 1.0 and bedGain(0) = 0, that a forest-to-swamp zone change fades the old bed to zero over the fade time while the new bed rises, that a hit cue on enemy B never stops enemy A's voice, and that the first stinger plays once before the battle track when a fight starts.
